records.Concise description: Ordinals marketplace operated by The Wizards of Ord using wallet-authenticated PSBT flows; its terms disclaim platform custody while current listing mechanics use a scripted listing escrow output with a pre-signed recovery path.
records.Deeper researched summary: ORD.NET is a 2026-era Bitcoin Ordinals trading venue operated by The Wizards of Ord LLC. Its April 2026 terms describe a marketplace for browsing, buying, selling and managing inscriptions, state that the platform does not take custody of user assets or act as transaction counterparty, and state that it never has access to private keys. The live developer API shows why custody wording needs precision rather than a generic label: listing creation uses wallet-signed PSBTs that transfer the inscription into a listing escrow output, create a SINGLE|ANYONECANPAY settlement leg, and include a pre-signed recovery PSBT; purchases are then built by the service and signed by the buyer wallet before broadcast. The same API exposes live listings, sales and buyer/collection offers and requires wallet-challenge authentication rather than API keys. Marketplace order state and collection eligibility are service-layer data; inscription provenance and settlement remain tied to Bitcoin transactions plus Ordinals indexing.
Creators / founders: lifofifo (founder/developer, per Wizards of Ord site)
Nicole (artist, per Wizards of Ord site)
records.Launch / history: Public trading launched in 2026. First-party static documentation reviewed does not pin an exact launch day, so the registry does not invent one.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: ORD.NET is important as a post-consolidation Ordinals venue that appeared after several earlier marketplaces wound down and as one of the clearest first-party sources for modern Bitcoin marketplace transaction construction.
Important technical or cultural characte: wallet-authenticated API with BIP-322 challenge signatures
listing escrow output plus pre-signed seller recovery transaction
buyer wallet signs purchase funding inputs before service broadcast
off-chain marketplace order state layered over Bitcoin settlement and Ordinals indexing
marketplace and creator fee fields exposed in transaction preflight
records.Verification basis: Current April 2026 terms and live developer API were checked together. ACTIVE is supported by current order-book/trading API operation, not site reachability alone.
Research notes / uncertainties: Exact public launch day was not located in the reviewed first-party sources. Do not summarize the venue merely as 'non-custodial': the legal terms disclaim custody/private-key access, while the documented listing flow transfers inscriptions to a scripted listing escrow output and relies on service-built PSBTs plus a pre-signed recovery path. Recheck fee parameters before public copy because fee fields can change.

records.Concise description: Pro-trader Bitcoin marketplace for Ordinals and Runes with mempool-aware trading, bids, sweeps and PSBT-based API flows.
records.Deeper researched summary: Satflow is the Bitcoin marketplace built by Swap Labs for active Ordinals and Runes trading. Current product pages expose Ordinals and Runes markets, collection bids, sweeps, cancellation controls, mempool activity and loan-backed/BNPL functionality. Its API creates unsigned PSBT intents for bids, acceptances and purchases, which users sign in their wallets. The API can also construct external purchases through DotSwap; Magic Eden is explicitly deprecated and blocked, reflecting the 2026 marketplace transition. Satflow's public fee presentation has changed over time and currently contains promotional/comparison components that should not be treated as a timeless fixed fee.
records.Launch / history: Built by Swap Labs and publicly established as a Bitcoin-native trading platform before 2026; a 2024 seed round is independently documented. The registry focuses on current 2026 operation rather than making a precise launch-date claim not established in reviewed first-party pages.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Satflow matters as a specialist high-frequency/pro-trader venue, a current source of Ordinals and Runes liquidity, and a useful example of off-chain marketplace/order intent coordination settling through user-signed Bitcoin transactions.
records.Verification basis: Current homepage and API references were used to verify active markets, supported Bitcoin assets and signing flow; operator/founder attribution is corroborated independently.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not publish a fixed Satflow platform-fee percentage as timeless copy without a same-day check: current pages have displayed promotional and comparison fee language that is not fully consistent. PSBT use proves wallet signing, not by itself every aspect of custody for every feature such as BNPL.

records.Concise description: UniSat's decentralized marketplace product for BRC-20, Ordinals, Runes, Alkanes, Names and collections.
records.Deeper researched summary: UniSat Marketplace is a distinct trading product inside the broader UniSat wallet/indexer/inscription ecosystem. First-party documentation says it launched in 2023 and supports Bitcoin-native assets including BRC-20, Ordinals, Runes, Alkanes, Names and Collections, with no third-party bridge or custodian required. Users connect compatible wallets and sign transactions/PSBTs. The marketplace's breadth across inscription and fungible-token standards makes it one of the core multi-protocol Bitcoin trading venues. UniHexa, a newer UniSat trading engine, is separately described by UniSat as beta/invite-stage and should not be split into a second canonical Marketplace profile yet.
Creators / founders: UniSat team; individual founders were not established in the reviewed first-party sources
records.Launch / history: Launched in 2023. UniSat subsequently expanded from BRC-20/Ordinals into Runes and other Bitcoin/Fractal asset standards. UniHexa remains a product transition/beta to watch rather than a separate canonical entity.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: UniSat was one of the earliest major BRC-20 venues and became a durable multi-asset Bitcoin marketplace with strong wallet/indexer integration.
records.Verification basis: Current official product documentation establishes active operation, asset scope and the no-third-party-custodian claim.
Research notes / uncertainties: Canonical-home conflict: UniSat is also a major wallet/indexer entity. MSC should keep one master canonical entity or explicitly approve product-level profiles across categories; this record represents the materially distinct Marketplace product and should relationally link to WALLETS. Fee schedules can be promotional and must be date-qualified.

records.Concise description: Combined Bitcoin wallet and marketplace with deep Ordinals support plus Runes, BRC-20 and TAP/DMT trading surfaces.
records.Deeper researched summary: Ordinals Wallet combines a self-custodial BTC/Ordinals wallet with a substantial marketplace. The current site exposes Ordinals, Runes, BRC-20 and TAP/DMT-oriented markets. Its 2026 PSBT explainer describes the common listing model in which a seller signs SIGHASH_SINGLE|ANYONECANPAY, the inscription remains in the seller wallet, and the buyer later adds payment inputs and completes settlement in one Bitcoin transaction. The same first-party material says off-chain listing cancellation is free on its model, while spending the inscription UTXO also invalidates a listing. The product's operator is Twetch Inc. d/b/a Ordinals Wallet per its privacy policy.
Creators / founders: Twetch Inc. d/b/a Ordinals Wallet; individual founders were not reliably established from reviewed first-party sources
records.Launch / history: Emerging in the first wave of Ordinals infrastructure in early 2023, Ordinals Wallet became both a wallet and marketplace and was among early venues adding BRC-20 trading.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Its significance is the tight combination of asset custody UX, inscription-aware wallet behavior and marketplace liquidity, plus early participation in both Ordinals and BRC-20 trading.
records.Verification basis: Current marketplace/wallet pages and 2026 technical explainer were checked; Galaxy is used only for early ecosystem context.
Research notes / uncertainties: Canonical-home conflict is material: this should not silently become a duplicate WALLETS profile in the master registry. First-party comparative guides from Ordinals Wallet contain stale peer-marketplace claims (notably Magic Eden after its shutdown), so they are used only for Ordinals Wallet's own mechanics and not as authority on competitors.
